summary: The core history and the CURRENT FACTS items agree across the dossiers. That covers the 2025-26 record, the LaMelo trade, Cup Group C, the Feb 15 game, and no opener or Christmas game. The errors were mostly stale or garbled details. The CIAA Tournament sat in Charlotte after it left in 2020. Jordan Brand was dated to 2014 instead of 2017. Honeycomb was placed in the 1988-2002 era. Bobby Jones was put at South Mecklenburg. Luke Combs's upbringing, Hive dates, Dell Curry's role and the home Cup-night count were also wrong. All fixed in place. Three live checks came back. Black Sheep Skate Shop exists, but its location is unconfirmed. SC's tax-free weekend is real (Aug 7-9, 2026). Brooks' Sandwich House is open, but its land is for sale. Still open: venue and small-business status, Brandon Miller's Puma deal, Steph Curry's shoe status, the City Edition, the arena name, and the Duke-UNC and festival dates strategy.json builds on. The editor must fix the strategy brief's Cup-night count and its Puma and Black Sheep wording.
